name: Aside
notes: YC-backed macOS AI browser whose agent works directly in your logged-in websites, handling messages, payments and internal tools, with local memory built from browsing history, an agent-safe password vault and approval before sensitive actions. Requested via the form (issue #192).
tagline: The most intelligent AI assistant, but it’s a browser.
